sentences.text:
1 "It is therefore, mostly respectfully prayed that the writ petition may kindly be allowed and that the respondent department may be directed to award compensation along with the requisite interest rates [2023:RJ-JD:43327] (2 of 3) [CW-16272/2021]
as per Section 77 and 80 of Right to Fair Compensation And Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013".

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation And Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are having right, title and ownership of certain pieces of land along with the requisite documents.
He submits that certain part of the land which belonged to the petitioners was used for construction/widening of the National Highway No.65 by the respondent State.
He submits that although the lands have been utilized for construction/widening of the National Highway but no compensation has been paid so far to the petitioners.

Therefore, he prays that petitioners may be permitted to approach the respondent No.2 - Secretary, Jodhpur Development Authority, Jodhpur by way of filing a detailed representation along with the necessary documents for redressal of their grievances.

4. Learned counsel for the respondent No.2 very fairly submits that if the petitioners appear before the respondent No.2 along with all the requisite documents, the respondent No.2 shall pass an appropriate order after giving reasonable opportunity of hearing to the petitioners in accordance with law.

5. Considering the submissions made before this Court, the present writ petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to approach the respondent No.2- Secretary, Jodhpur Development Authority, Jodhpur by way of filing a representation along with necessary documents and the respondent No.2 after giving reasonable opportunity of hearing to the petitioners shall decide the same in accordance with law at the earliest preferably within a period of eight weeks from the receipt of such representation along with the documents strictly in accordance with law.

The stay application and other pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.
(VINIT KUMAR MATHUR),J 41-SanjayS/-
